scope: Native desktop terminal retention and owned subscription lifetimes; no app/server/protocol or Android source changes. Installed clients and port 6767 unchanged.

environment.fixture: Real isolated daemon and five real Node PTYs; no model calls or user agents

canvasComparison.purpose: Same native terminal scroll position before leaving and after returning, within each build; not an Electron/native parity comparison

linuxGui: ten A/B switches preserve scroll without resubscribe
hidden A receives output while B is selected; inspected after return
four-terminal LRU retains three views and reuses A/C
delayed A/B binding then workspace leave delivers earlya/earlyb exactly once
late terminal and directory owners release after leaving workspace
SDK-closing hidden A removes its tab while B retains its stream
SDK-closing selected B removes the view; C/D/E remain live
real 30-second timeout, reselect, old binding release and same E recovery
minimize, hidden output and restore retain the stream and reclaim size ownership
three pending bindings protect their views; a fourth open preserves F focus and exact input, then succeeds after binding
two delayed workspace directory snapshots cannot replace the latest workspace inventory
client close leaves the same three PTY IDs and E output alive
existing fake-provider Agent history renders after owned subscription negotiation; returning to E reuses its stream

limitations: No overall latency, CPU or RSS performance claim; retaining up to three buffers may use more resident memory than retaining one.
No complete terminal or desktop acceptance. Pixel parity with Electron remains NOT_PASSED.
Mac/Windows checks are compilation only; GPU, GUI, IME and end-to-end behavior remain pending.
Reconnect, offline input delivery, full-window close with unacknowledged input, selection/copy/paste, complete keyboard/mouse modes and terminal images remain pending.
Original empty/loading/error UI parity remains pending.
Embedded Agent footer work is postponed and preserved separately.
deployment: Not deployed. All QA native windows, fake agent, fixture PTYs/home, window manager and display cleaned; see cleanup.json.
